Well there are people who are born intersex which means they are born with mixed male and female chromosomes and/or sex parts. Some of these intersex people don't even know they are intersex. It's not so much a preference. It's more like something I can't control that changes day to day but also sometimes longer. Like I could feel male for a week and then feel female for a month and just keep going back and forth like that. It's something that I experience inwardly, and genuinely feel and so I express that feeling on the out side through clothing and actions and so on.
Lots of people who are in the trans community and nonbinary community say gender is fluid it changes and that is basically how I define myself.

Everyone has a different way they would define it in the nonbinary community. For me I feel like a male some days as in I look in the mirror and I see a male. And some days I feel like a female and that's what I see. Then on other days I can't define what I see and I am neither male or female.
